title: Teessoo Dhugaa
intro: Bulchaan humna guddaa qabu, ogummaa guddaa fi teessoo isaanii isa dinqisiisaa ta’een kan beekamu, ergaa dhoksaa madda hin beekamne irraa argatu. Walqunnamtiin hin eegamne kun amantii fi aangoo isaanii morma, imala dippilomaasii sammuu isaanii qoratee dhumarratti dammaqiinsa hafuuraa gadi fagootti isaan geessu irratti isaan kaa’a. Eenyummaa abbaa biyyummaa kanaa fi taateewwan mootummaa isaanii guutuu jijjiiran saaxiluu dandeessaa?
clues: Aniifi sabni koo karaa abbootii keenyaa hordofnee aduu sagadaa turre.
Simbirroon, hoopoe, ergamaa hin fakkaanne kan xalayaa hogganaa humna guddaa qabu irraa naaf fide ture.
Ogummaa nama erge qorachuuf, kennaa gatii guddaa qabu erge, garuu deebi’e, sababiin isaas namni erge qabeenya Rabbii irraa baay’ee caalu waan qabuuf.
Mana murtii nama erge sanaa illee osoon hin ga’iin teessoo koo inni dinqisiisaa ta’e ija jaamsuu keessatti dinqiidhaan garasitti geejjibame.
Yeroon achi gahu teessoo geejjibame sun kan koo taʼuu isaa kan na gaafatan siʼa taʼu, anis, ‘Akka waan isa sana taʼeetti’ jedheen deebiseef.
Galma guddaa lafa bishaan kuufamaa jedhee dogoggore tokkon seene, yeroo ajaa’ibsiifannaa sana keessatti Nabi Suleeymaan cinatti Rabbii Gooftaa adunyaatiif of kenne.

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
